newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea key bond yields close flat, call rate down.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea key bond yields close flat, call rate down.

text.p: Both three-year and three-month benchmark bond yields closed flat on Friday, and the overnight call rate fell, dealers said.
Three-year yields fell in early trading but settled back later amid mixed forecasts about the future trend, they said.
The market reopened after Thursday's market holiday.
* Average overnight call at 13.94 pct vs Wednesday's 14.39
The Bank of Korea is due to review won reserve levels on Wednesday next week.
Kim said three-year yields were expected to move in a range from 12.40 percent to 12.55 percent this month.
Three-month CD yields closed flat in slow trading. Both demand and supply were low for CDs, dealers said.
The average overnight call rate fell to 13.94 pct from 14.39 pct on Wednesday, but the rate was rising towards the close.
